description: This file defines a policy for managing Flutter's in-memory image cache, including configuration, trimming, and lifecycle management via app state observation.

classes.name: AppImageCachePolicy
classes.description: Provides static methods to configure and trim the Flutter in-memory image cache.

classes.name: ImageCacheLifecycleObserver
classes.description: Observes app lifecycle events and triggers cache trimming upon specific state changes.

methods.name: configureMemoryCache
methods.description: Sets limits for Flutter's in-memory image cache, including maximum size and bytes.

methods.name: trimMemoryCache
methods.description: Clears the image cache and optionally clears live images to free memory.
